The line begins at the 2010 mark on the far left and terminates at the 2015 mark on the far right.
The line ascends from a lower vertical position on the left (2010) to a higher vertical position on the right (2015).
The line is the only graphical mark present within the axes.

uncertain: The chart title explicitly states 'Shrinking Population', which contradicts the visual evidence of the line moving upward from 2,000 to 3,000.
